dsh-plugin-call-trace 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。持久化模型工具调用轨迹记录器：每次工具调用落盘为 JSONL（重启不丢），提供结构化 call_trace 查询工具与 callTraceHistory 服务，支持文件大小轮转，附可选浮层画布 UI。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-c6468bd9f0bcf840159a.html
posts.en:
dsh-plugin-call-trace is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Persistent model tool-call trace recorder: every tool call is durably written to a JSONL file that survives restarts, queryable via a structured call_trace tool and a callTraceHistory service, with size rotation and an optional floating canvas UI add-on.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-c6468bd9f0bcf840159a.html
